candidate_rule: One fixed conservative shape: 900Hz section x0.70, 1300Hz x0.85, 1900/2600 unchanged; frozen low section unchanged. Selection: prefer conservative only if >0.5dB failure count decreases and group-equal MAE cost <=0.20dB.
limitations: All source material is October 2026-10-02; internal block tests are not independent-session validation.
The 4x peak is a numerical approximation using resampling, not a standardized true-peak meter.
Window scores use a fixed low-only anchor and frequency mask, so quantify target-band timbre rather than absolute level or entire recording quality.
